sources.entry: IPTVMac - Native IPTV player for Xtream Codes and M3U playlists, with instant search, a built-in mpv player, Picture in Picture and catch-up.

summary.one_liner: IPTVMac is a free, open-source native IPTV player for Mac, Windows, Android and Android TV that plays Xtream Codes and M3U playlists.
summary.what_it_does: It loads Xtream Codes and M3U playlists into a local SQLite database with full-text search across live channels, movies and series. Playback uses a bundled mpv (libmpv) engine with subtitle support (embedded tracks and external .srt/.ass files), hardware decoding and automatic reconnection. Features include Picture in Picture, catch-up on Xtream tv_archive channels, EPG program info, downloads for offline viewing, resume and next-episode countdown, and a sleep timer. Settings cover backup and restore of playlists (without passwords), favorites and watch history, and 31 interface languages. The Mac app checks for updates and verifies an Ed25519 signature and SHA-256 before installing them.
use_cases: watch IPTV channels on a Mac
play an M3U playlist from a provider
watch Xtream Codes streams on Android TV or Fire TV
search channels, movies and series quickly
watch a live channel in a floating Picture in Picture window
catch up on past TV programs with archive support
download movies or episodes for offline viewing on Android or Windows
how_to_run: curl -fsSL <install.sh URL missing in README> | bash  (one-line Mac install; URL is blank in the README)
Or download IPTVMac.dmg from the latest GitHub release and drag it to Applications
Windows: download the setup .exe or portable zip from the release page
Android: download the arm64-v8a APK from GitHub Releases and install it
Build from source (Mac): brew install mpv pkgconf
notable: One engine (libmpv) shared across Mac, Windows, Android and Android TV apps, with each app written in its platform's native language
Full-text search across the whole library, scoped to category, section or everywhere
Signed self-updates verified with a pinned Ed25519 key and SHA-256
No accounts and no analytics; the app contacts only the servers you add and GitHub for updates
Built-in demo playlist and a suggested free public M3U playlist of about 11,000 entries
caveats: Mac version requires Apple Silicon (M1 or later) and macOS 14 or later; Intel Macs are not supported
iPhone and iPad app is not released yet (waiting for App Store review)
Account passwords are stored in plain text in the local database, not in the Keychain
Windows build is unsigned, so SmartScreen warns; Android TV has no store listing and no downloads; updates there are manual
